checks.name: framing-collision-under-the-pre-change-algorithm
checks.summary: PC4's claim measured against the real pre-change binary, not asserted. Two synthetic single-component trees were built, one holding file 'a' with content 'bc' and one holding file 'ab' with content 'c', with roots ['a','ab'] and the same component id in both so that only the path/content split differs. The pre-change ci-plan at 26a499d returned the identical key b18e822f21a051952ac7742e6e494decd7ea6529864e329c11e142ae563d88e8 for both. The v2 framing returns two different keys, and re-injecting the old framing into the new code reproduces a collision (19bdef7a93e6...), which is what PC4 now guards. PC4 is realised as one synthetic component over two synthetic trees rather than two components over one tree, because two different component ids would differ in the key for a reason other than framing.
